messages.title: A premium spray-tan service — with a second client-care moment after the appointment
messages.preview: A trial-first way to explore treatment value and relevant aftercare for your clients.
messages.headline: A premium tan is one appointment. The client relationship can continue after it.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},

I’m reaching out because {{BUSINESS_NAME}} looks like the kind of {{BUSINESS_TYPE}} we would like to speak with: thoughtful presentation, premium service and clients who care how their color looks beyond the treatment room.
Sunless by Jimmy Coco brings believable, natural-looking color, a named service you can present as premium, and a focused aftercare edit for clients who want to maintain the result between visits.

items: A relevant aftercare recommendation once the client sees a result they love.

blocks.html: Eligible U.S. professional partners can request a complimentary 100 ml professional trial sample. We review current availability for your business before shipping.
Or reply INFO and we will keep it straightforward.

messages.title: The result is what gives a premium tan its value
messages.preview: A natural-looking, considered finish that supports a stronger consultation and service story.
messages.eyebrow: The result beyond the treatment room
messages.headline: A premium service has to look worth coming back for.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},
The test of a professional tan is how it reads later—in daylight, in photographs, in evening light and at the event the client booked it for.

Malibu Professional Spray is presented as a universal bronze, 10% DHA formula with a stated 6–8-hour development window. Professional guidance recommends under 35 ml for a full-body application and confirms compatibility with standard HVLP systems.
That supports a believable, polished finish and a more valuable consultation: considered depth and a finish designed to look natural, rather than simply darker.

messages.title: The commercial question is not “what does it cost?” It is “what can the service support?”
messages.preview: Review the treatment, operating and aftercare opportunity using your own service model.
messages.headline: Build the numbers around your business—not a generic margin claim.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},
A premium product becomes a commercial opportunity only when it fits the way your business actually operates.

items: The premium service price that fits your market.
Your own solution use, labor, disposables and payment costs.
The client result and consultation experience you want to deliver.
The aftercare product that naturally answers the client’s next question.

blocks.html: The formula trial lets you test the result first. A short Partnership review can then help you assess whether the treatment and aftercare route fit your business before you make a wider decision.
Or reply NUMBERS for a human conversation about your current treatment setup.

messages.title: One client relationship. Two useful revenue moments.
messages.preview: A simple treatment-plus-aftercare routine for a salon, studio or mobile professional.
messages.headline: Retail should feel like client care—not a hard sell.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},
The best retail moment is often just after a client sees a result they love and asks how to keep it looking good until the next appointment.

items: Buff & Glow Mitt: a more even-looking maintenance routine.
Self Tan Soufflé: a controlled at-home top-up.
A-List Glow Kit: a complete routine or elevated gift option.

blocks.html: For a fixed salon, this can begin as a three-product checkout edit. For a mobile professional, it can begin as a small carry kit. Current availability, order route and partner terms are reviewed with the individual business before any retail plan is set.
Or reply RETAIL for the checkout or mobile-kit conversation.

messages.title: Should I close this out for now?
messages.preview: A final note from Sunless Partnerships.
messages.headline: I’ll leave the timing with you.

blocks.html: Hi {{FIRST_NAME}},

Sunless by Jimmy Coco may be relevant to {{BUSINESS_NAME}} if you are considering a more distinctive spray-tan offer: a premium client result, a service model you can assess using your own operating numbers, and a small aftercare edit for clients who want to maintain the result.

items: Trial: assess the professional formula on a real client.
NUMBERS: discuss your current service model before considering a wider route.
RETAIL: discuss a small aftercare edit for a fixed salon, studio or mobile kit.

blocks.html: If the timing is not right, no problem. We will close this sequence here.
